 Judgment

The present appeal is filed by the appellant/claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 14.03.2017 passed in MVC.No.361/2016 by the Senior Civil Judge and Motor Accident Claims Tribunal at Holalkere, for enhancement of compensation.

The compensation awarded by the Tribunal is on the lesser side.
Hence, the claimant is entitled for enhancement of compensation.
7. Considering the nature of injuries sustained, compensation of Rs.60,000/- is awarded towards injury, pain and suffering as against Rs.40,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.
The compensation amount awarded by the Tribunal under the head medical expenses is as per the actual bills produced, which needs no interference.
Hence, it is kept in tact.
9. The doctor has assessed the permanent disability 42% and the Tribunal has taken 15% as disability, which is found to be just and proper.
As the claimant is aged 21 years, the appropriate multiplier applicable is 18.
As the accident is of the year 2015, income of Rs.9,000/- is to be taken into consideration as per the Notional Income Chart recognized by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority.

Therefore, compensation under the head loss of income due to disability is hereby re-assessed and quantified as follows:
Rs.9,000/- x 15% x 18 x 12=Rs.2,91,600/-
NC: 2024:KHC:20412
Accordingly, compensation of Rs.2,91,600/- is awarded under the head loss of future income as against Rs.1,78,200/- awarded by the Tribunal.
10. The compensation of Rs.27,000/- (Rs.9,000/- pm., x 3 months) is awarded under the head loss of income during laid up period as against Rs.10,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.
11. The compensation of Rs.15,000/- is awarded under the head attendant charges as against Rs.5,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.
12. The compensation of Rs.15,000/- awarded by the Tribunal towards future medical expenses is found to be just and proper.
Hence, it is kept in tact.

15.
The Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.3,38,200/-, but the appellant/claimant is entitled to total compensation of Rs.4,78,600/-.
Hence, the appellant/claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.1,40,400/- (Rs.4,78,600/- - Rs.3,38,200/-).

Therefore, the appellant/claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.1,40,400/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization, in addition to what has been awarded NC: 2024:KHC:20412 by the Tribunal.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i. Appeal is allowed-in-part.

ii. The impugned judgment and award dated 14.03.2017 passed in MVC.No.361/2016 by the Senior Civil Judge and Motor Accident Claims Tribunal at Holalkere, is modified to the extent that the appellant/claimant is entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.1,40,400/-
along with the rate of interest at 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization,
in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.
